description: Ledger 13 attribution controls and three-seed capacity-estimator calibration.

siege_cell_decisions.rationale: Ledger 13 replicated the absence of Kerr intensity advantage across three paired seeds and attributed dominant degree-two capacity to square-law observation.
siege_cell_decisions.decision_scope: Three paired normalized noiseless seeds at one dynamical point; no broad obstruction follows.

siege_cell_decisions.rationale: Ledger 13 identified a small replicated Kerr-associated lag-three/four linear-memory lead requiring a predeclared detector-noise attack.
siege_cell_decisions.decision_scope: Local normalized noiseless lead only; detector noise, readout amplification, and physical observability remained unresolved.

conjectures.label: Kerr quadrature linear-memory lead
conjectures.statement: At detector-observation-noise standard deviation 1e-8 at the frozen normalized point, the Kerr lag-three and lag-four linear targets will remain family-wise significant across seeds 20260810-20260812, and every matched Kerr-minus-disabled corrected-capacity delta will remain positive.

conjecture_dispositions.rationale: Ledger 13 retained the noiseless quadrature lead specifically for a predeclared normalized detector-noise falsification attempt.
conjecture_dispositions.decision_scope: Pre-test local normalized-model conjecture; not nonlinear computation, detector calibration, material validation, or Conjecture 5.

falsification_criteria.description: At detector-noise std 1e-8, the Kerr lag-three target must be family-wise significant in every seed and every matched Kerr-minus-disabled delta must be positive.
falsification_criteria.metric: lag-three cross-seed signed lower-envelope corrected-capacity delta
falsification_criteria.threshold_text: Kerr significance 3/3 and positive paired delta 3/3

falsification_criteria.description: At detector-noise std 1e-8, the Kerr lag-four target must be family-wise significant in every seed and every matched Kerr-minus-disabled delta must be positive.
falsification_criteria.metric: lag-four cross-seed signed lower-envelope corrected-capacity delta
falsification_criteria.threshold_text: Kerr significance 3/3 and positive paired delta 3/3

protocols.name: Ledger 13 attribution and estimator calibration
protocols.decision_scope: Eight-case normalized attribution suite, three seeds, joint-family permutations, and correlated split-sensitivity checks.

runs.summary: Intensity readout showed no Kerr advantage; coherent quadrature showed a small positive three-seed linear-memory difference at lags three and four. No nonlinear target replicated. Weak Kerr feature scales left physical observability unresolved.

gate_results.decision_scope: Matched Kerr-minus-disabled quadrature comparison at one normalized dynamical point.
gate_results.limitation: The replicated targets were linear; detector noise and readout amplification were not yet charged.

gate_results.decision_scope: Degree-two or degree-three quadrature targets required to survive all three seeds.
gate_results.limitation: Three seeds at one normalized noiseless point; no broad impossibility follows.
